NOTES, none blocking: merging before the env deploy makes the audit report one DRIFT on reclaim (mirror False, env still true), self-clearing on deploy, expected post-deploy state 26 mirrored / 0 drift / 10 unset; settings.py code defaults stay 2.0/5.0 (guarded by test_exit_logic_cw.py:66-67), so after deploy the env file alone holds live at 5/8 and an env rebuild would silently revert live while every backtest models 5/8, landing in the audit's quiet 'unset' bucket rather than drift; nothing schedules audit_live_locked_drift.py in either crontab; and every RTH/EH scenario test is now pinned to 2/5, so no test exercises the replay at the live +5/-8 frame.
